# The same fund, stated finer than the account it sits on can hold.
#
# 12.3456 units against an account kept to thousandths is refused — but for
# the account's reason, not the currency's. The refusal has two branches and
# a security can only ever fail the account one, so naming the currency here
# tells the reader to round to two places when three are legal, and calls
# fund units "not money this book can record" when they are not money at all.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming 0.001 and the account, and a
# suggestion to give the account a `commodity_scu:` that can hold the figure.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_amount_must_fit_the_currency.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity FUNDX
	mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	fullname: "Example Balanced Fund"
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Fund
	type: Mutual Fund
	commodity.namespace: "FUND"
	commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
	commodity_scu: 1000

2026-02-01 * "Buy 12.3456 units"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Fund 12.3456 FUNDX
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "FUNDX"
		share_price: "100"
		value: "1234.56"
	Assets:Bank -1234.56 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
